mapper.select: select id, activity_id, user_id, status, expire_time, create_time from activity_enrollment where status = 0 and expire_time < now()

select ae.id, ae.activity_id, ae.user_id, ae.status, ae.expire_time, ae.create_time, a.title, a.location from activity_enrollment ae join activity a on a.id = ae.activity_id where ae.user_id = #{userId} order by ae.create_time desc, ae.id desc
